title: Temporary content interruption

location.extent: Published video poster; complete local video linked

slide_intent: Keep an operational message stable while the identity moves, because viewers need time to read why their programme is unavailable.
strategic_value: The fixed black message over a shifting gradient can maintain Channel 4’s visual continuity during a service interruption.
demonstration: Across the 24-second clip, a four-line notice about unavailable +1 content remains fixed near the upper left while the pink and lavender room-like gradient shifts; a narrow green field stays at the left edge.
practical_value: Decide which information must remain stationary when ambient brand motion continues behind it.

content_islands.name: Service notice
content_islands.spec: Hold the black notice near the upper left with consistent line breaks throughout the clip.

content_islands.name: Moving background
content_islands.spec: Shift the pink and lavender recessed gradient behind the text while retaining the green strip at left.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study explains that the worlds transform to contain functional content as well as narrative idents.
reference_purposes.Expression: Across the 24-second clip, a four-line notice about unavailable +1 content remains fixed near the upper left while the pink and lavender room-like gradient shifts; a narrow green field stays at the left edge.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in an on-screen service-interruption notice.
